g.text: a transport map names which claim moved, by how much, and what kind of failure it was, so every finding becomes a rule the agent can follow
how far it had to go
with its weight and its cost,
a claim was dropped or invented
its weight split three ways at high cost
no single counterpart anywhere in the source
one claim’s weight, spread across three unrelated targets
nothing in the source carries it
it matched cleanly, one target, low cost
but it sits twelve positions from where it belonged
the words survived, the running order did not
the claim and the size of the miss
the ruleset feeds the next run
that is the whole content of a
no location, no size, no type, so there is nothing here to write a rule from
a score answers ‘did it get worse’. a plan answers ‘what do I change’.
the mechanism, not a measured gain - this loop is not benchmarked
